observations.label: Governing coalition continuity
observations.summary: The fracture signal moved from peripheral figures to the founding bargain itself. Four independent signals point the same way: the vice president's seat was moved out of the president's side at the 20 July cabinet session, known Jokowi critics entered the government, the two principals meet rarely, and the president stayed silent on the Jokowi diploma dispute. Jokowi loyalists Budi Arie and Karding were removed. Both camps deny a rift and the palace calls the seating a technical arrangement, so this is a signal set, not an institutional rupture.

observations.label: Institutional checks event pool
observations.summary: Bank Indonesia governor Perry Warjiyo resigned roughly two years before his term ended. Senior Deputy Governor Destry Damayanti took over in an acting capacity from the 26 July board meeting and the government confirmed the resignation on 27 July, citing personal reasons. A fixed term is the only institutional device insulating the central bank, so an unexplained early exit voids that device in practice. A permanent successor still needs parliamentary approval, so capture is not yet an accomplished fact. Only capture and independence events contribute here; macro outcomes do not.

observations.summary: JCI 6,401 vs 8,646.93 at 2025-12-30 close is -25.97% in rupiah and -30.7% in USD after the 16,720->17,856 currency move; the prior -35% was an estimate, so the difference is a change of method, not a market recovery. Year-to-date foreign net selling is about IDR 97.1tn. Two access signals this week are recorded but do not move the score: FTSE Russell again deferred Indonesian additions and tier changes to the December 2026 review, and MSCI removed GOTO and CPIN from the Global Standard index. The band is defined on USD return alone and cannot absorb index-provider decisions. From 2026-08-20 the production V3 also carries a separate 国际市场准入 driver (weight 0.06, carved out of 股市与外资流向) so index-provider access decisions score somewhere instead of being recorded as evidence only.

observations.label: Online grievance proxy
observations.summary: The 2026-08-18 scheduled run refused to score at 60% effective source weight against a 65% floor. A manual re-run on 08-20 reached 90% coverage (only GDELT tone missing on a 429) and produced composite heat 43.2 (up from 32.6) and an opposition rate of 34.8% (from 37.2%). The headline rate barely moved but its composition reversed: grassroots YouTube 39%->51% while mainstream RSS fell 34%->9%, widening the grassroots-media gap from 5pp to 42pp. Driver score 60%x59 + 40%x55 = 57.
